introduction: North Carolina weatherization improves home efficiency for eligible households. Apply to the designated local provider.
description: North Carolina weatherization improves home efficiency for eligible households. Apply to the designated local provider.

sections.who: Income and household conditions apply. Priority includes older or disabled members, children and high energy burdens.
sections.get: An audit identifies appropriate efficiency and energy-related safety work. No particular upgrade is guaranteed.
sections.docs:
• Income information.
  • Energy bills.
  • Property or landlord permission records requested.
sections.apply:
1. Find the agency

    Use DEQ’s Find Your Agency tool.

  2. Complete intake

    The provider reviews eligibility and documents.

  3. Arrange assessment

    The audit produces the work scope before installation.
sections.after: A final inspection checks completed work and explains operation.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using NC weatherization process; Eligibility guidelines. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
